title: Time Value of Money (TVM) - computing the rate of interest (for the CFA Level 1 exam)
description:
Time Value of Money - computing the rate of interest (for the CFA Level 1 exam) explores the steps needed to solve for I/Y using both the TVM worksheet on the Texas Instruments BA II Plus calculator and the relevant longhand mathematical expression.

For a comprehensive directory of all videos featured on this channel, please visit the channel companion website: www.letmeexplain.eu
